name: Compute Cluster S64: Channel Breakout & Price Envelopes
description: Tests: donchian_channel(window), keltner_channels(roll_period, band_multiplier), acceleration_bands(period, multiplier). Upper/lower/middle outputs, breakout detection.
source:
# =============================================================================
# COMPUTE CLUSTER S64: Channel Breakout
# =============================================================================

src = study_assets()
close = src.c
high = src.h
low = src.l

# === DONCHIAN CHANNEL (Turtle Trading) ===
dc = donchian_channel(high, low, window=20)
dc_upper = dc.donchian_upper
dc_lower = dc.donchian_lower
dc_middle = dc.donchian_middle

# === KELTNER CHANNELS ===
kc = keltner_channels(high, low, close, roll_period=20, band_multiplier=2.0)
kc_upper = kc.upper_band
kc_lower = kc.lower_band

# === ACCELERATION BANDS ===
ab = acceleration_bands(period=20, multiplier=4.0)(high, low, close)
ab_upper = ab.upper_band
ab_lower = ab.lower_band
ab_middle = ab.middle_band

# === BREAKOUT DETECTION ===
dc_breakout_up = close > dc_upper
dc_breakout_dn = close < dc_lower

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='Donchian Channel (20)',
    category='Channels',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Upper', color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Lower', color=Color.Red),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Middle', color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(dc_upper, dc_lower, dc_middle))

xy_lines(
    title='Keltner Channels (20, 2.0 ATR)',
    category='Channels',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Upper', color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Lower', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(kc_upper, kc_lower))

xy_lines(
    title='Acceleration Bands (20, 4.0)',
    category='Channels',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Upper', color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Middle', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Lower', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(ab_upper, ab_middle, ab_lower))

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Close', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ],
        title='Donchian Breakout Up'
    )
)((close, dc_breakout_up))
